assumptions_made_explicit: the measurement window is finite and nonempty
each coordinate uses a fixed nonidentity Hermitian involutive n-qubit Pauli representative
measurement representatives are distinct modulo phase, so duplicate and plus/minus-duplicate classes are excluded
contexts are inclusion-maximal commuting subsets of the fixed window, not maximum-cardinality subsets
admissible signs are phase-aware and exclude minus identity from the generated signed Pauli subgroup
conditional_theorem_inputs: candidatePhysical: every normalized maximal-context candidate belongs to the projected stabilizer polytope
atomRefinement: every projected pure stabilizer atom is a convex mixture of maximal-context candidates

graph_policy.vrep_graph_usage: Only the elementary anticommutation-edge/commuting-context dictionary is used here.
graph_policy.perfect_graph_results: Outside the V-representation theorem. The same Lean package fixes exact finite weighted graph quantities and exposes WeightedPerfectGraphFoundation as an explicit external theorem parameter; it does not prove or axiomatically assert Chvatal's theorem.

non_inheritance_guards: A kernel-checked implication does not kernel-check its unproved premises.
The aggregate normalized V-representation remains PARTIALLY_FORMALIZED.
The failed published proof remains permanently recorded and is not overwritten by the repair chain.
No physical approximation or empirical evidence is involved.
